photos.alt: Child follows a painter’s tape path on a wooden floor with adult supervision.
Child taps upside-down kitchen pots with wooden spoons beside an adult.

steps.title: Tape Shape Maze
steps.body: Make a path with painter’s tape. Let little feet follow the shapes.

steps.title: Kitchen Pot Drumming
steps.body: Set out pots and wooden spoons. Tap a rhythm together.
